text:
Maya L.: Heads up — launching a Culture Care Crate pilot to send small care packages to new hires and recent spot award recipients. Goal: ship next Tue/Wed. Volunteers to help pack + confirm addresses + final invoice by Thu?
Jordan R.: Count me in for packing on Tue morning. Can we get a firm headcount by Mon EOD?
Aisha P.: I can pull addresses from the HR spreadsheet and remove opt-outs. Link?
Maya L.: Thanks! Here’s the sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1abc... (only People Ops and Logistics). Please add any dietary/allergy notes in the 'notes' column.
Ken T.: Do we have a vendor for the boxes/stickers? Budget code?
Logistics - Ops: Vendor: CrateCo (acct 9987). Shipping quote attached in the sheet. Budget GL: ENG-CRATE-2026. We can do express for EMEA if needed.
Samir: How many crates per region? I’d like to estimate labeling time.
Maya L.: Pilot: 50 US, 30 EMEA, 10 APAC. Packing party Tue 9–12 in 4th-floor kitchen. @People Ops Bot can you create a calendar invite?
People Ops Bot: Calendar event created: Culture Crate Packing — Tue 9:00–12:00 in 4th-floor kitchen. RSVP link: /rsvp
Aisha P.: I’ll prepare printed address labels. Do we want hand-written notes or printed inserts?
Jordan R.: Hand-written for US, printed for bulk EMEA. volunteers ok with handwriting?
Ken T.: :thumbsup: I can write notes with templates. Suggest a short script: "Thanks for everything — here's a small token of appreciation from Redwood."
Samir: We’ll need tape guns and scissors. Add to checklist.
Maya L.: packing checklist (copy to sheet):
```
- boxes x90
- tissue paper x90
- stickers x90
- snack pack x90 (nut-free labels)
- insert cards x90
- packing tape x6
- scissors x4
- marker pens x6
- address labels printed
```
Logistics - Ops: Reminder: final invoice cutoff Thu by 5pm PST. Please tag receipts in expense folder.
Aisha P.: Got it. I’ll filter opt-outs and confirm addresses by Mon 2pm.
Maya L.: Amazing — thanks team. If anyone can't make Tue packing but can prep inserts, reply here and I'll assign.
Jordan R.: I can't make Tue afternoon but can prep inserts Wed morning.
People Ops Bot: Shipment test label printed for EMEA sample. Tracking: TBD
Maya L.: :party_parrot: Love the momentum. Closing ask: volunteers + any shipping constraints by EOD today.
